examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evam'ev'assu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya. seyyathā'pi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evam'ev'assu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

18490.meaning1: (of snare, net, trap) laid down; planted; set
18490.commentary: (SNa) khippaṃ'va oḍḍitan'ti kuminaṃ viya oḍḍitaṃ. yathā macchā oḍḍitaṃ kuminaṃ pavisantā na jānanti, evaṃ sattā kilesakāmena vatthukāmaṃ vītikkamantā na jānantī'ti attho. (THa) maccupāsaṃ'va oḍḍitan'ti yathā maccussa maccurājassa pāsabhūto rūp'ādiko oḍḍito loke anuvicaritvā ṭhito ek'aṃsena sattānaṃ anatthāvaho, evaṃ sā'pi appaṭisaṅkhāne ṭhitānaṃ andhaputhujjanānaṃ ek'aṃsato anatth'āvahāti maccupāsasadisī vuttā.

examples.text: piṇḍikāya paviṭṭho'haṃ, gacchanto naṃ udikkhisaṃ, alaṅ'kataṃ suvasanaṃ, maccupāsaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ.
sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.

18491.commentary: (SNa) lepaṃ oḍḍentī'ti vaṭarukkhakhīr'ādīhi yojetvā lepaṃ karonti, taṃ makkaṭānaṃ dhuvagamanaṭṭhānan'ti sallakkhetvā rukkhasākh'ādīsu ṭhapenti.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, luddā makkaṭavīthīsu lepaṃ oḍḍenti makkaṭānaṃ bādhanāya.

18494.meaning1: who is low (now) and high (later); (presently) low status and high status (in future); inferior and superior

examples.text: katame cattāro? oṇat'oṇato, oṇat'uṇṇato, uṇṇat'oṇato, uṇṇat'uṇṇato. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

18495.meaning1: who is low (now and later); (presently) low status and low status (in future); inferior and inferior
18495.meaning2: low (in birth) and low (in moral behaviour), who begins low and stays low

examples.text: katame cattāro? oṇat'oṇato, oṇat'uṇṇato, uṇṇat'oṇato, uṇṇat'uṇṇato. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

18496.meaningLit: discourse on low now and later

18498.meaning1: who watches over a charge; keeper of property; protector of goods
18498.meaning2: who watches over a charge, who guards what has been entrusted to him
18498.commentary: (VINa) oṇiṃ rakkhatī'ti oṇirakkho. yo parena attano vasanaṭṭhāne ābhataṃ bhaṇḍaṃ idaṃ

examples.text: oṇirakkho nāma āhaṭaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ gopento pañcamāsakaṃ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṃ vā agghanakaṃ theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
